ai_emerging_top10.about: Multi-agent harness that runs Claude Code and Codex together as one system
ai_emerging_top10.readme_highlight: OpenRig is a multi-agent harness — it manages the system that coding agents form when you run them together. Not the agents themselves, but the team they create: which sessions are running, how they relate, how to recover after a reboot, and how to stop it from becoming terminal sprawl.
